memberdef.name: convert_samples

briefdescription.para: Convert the input audio samples into the output sample format.

detaileddescription.para:
The conversion happens on a per-frame basis, the size of which is specified by frame_size.
input_data
Samples to be decoded. The dimensions are channel (for multi-channel audio), sample.
converted_data
Converted samples. The dimensions are channel (for multi-channel audio), sample.
frame_size
Number of samples to be converted
resample_context
Resample context for the conversion
Error code (0 if successful)
